title: Add reusable Principle Guardian agent
summary: Added a Principle Guardian agent spec and persistent principle-adherence rules so all agents treat durable principles as enforceable gates.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.notes: Checked NIST AI RMF, OECD AI Principles, ISO/IEC 42001, and HRO references.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.notes: Reviewed existing durable principle anchors and repository status.

phases.label: Mode, boundary, and plan
phases.notes: Selected governance mode and agent-platform ownership.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.notes: Added REQ-WS-067, specs, source provenance, and plan evidence.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.notes: Added agent config, docs, persistent instruction updates, and history artifacts.

phases.label: Verification
phases.notes: Run agent inspection/list/orchestration, unit tests, memory/config/docs checks, workspace maps, task board, workspace health, and monitor collect/test/check/build.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.notes: Run omission, grounding, and work evaluator checks; write evaluation reports.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.notes: Commit and push are performed as the final close-out step after evaluation.

bottleneck_notes: Governance artifacts and durable instruction updates dominate this agent-only change.
The new agent reuses existing omission, grounding, evaluation, reconciliation, and resource checks instead of creating duplicate validators.
improvement_candidates: Create a reusable principle adherence brief template after real uses reveal stable conflict patterns.
